To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the sensitivity in the SCM receiver depends on the OMI and can be calculated as a function of this OMI.
the sensitivity in the SCM receiver depends on the transmitter OMI and the receiver OMI.
the receiver sensitivity in SCM links is limited by the nonlinearities in the optical IQ modulator and can be mathematically modelled.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of novel microwave-based SCM techniques for optical links, which will enable a direct processing of high-speed data at Gbit rates, and which are compatible with existing microwave technologies.
the mathematical analysis of the receiver sensitivities in microwave-based SCM links.
the mathematical modelling of the sensitivity of SCM and orthogonal SCM systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the receiver sensitivities of the optical IQ modulator based SCM and orthogonal SCM systems are limited by the nonlinearities of the optical IQ and the optical noise.
, for SCM and orthogonal SCM systems, the best sensitivities can be achieved with an optimum OMI of about 2.3, and that the sensitivity is inversely proportional to the OMI.

, in the presence of a nonlinear optical IQ modulator, the best achievable receiver sensitivities in an SCM link are achieved when the OMI is set equal to the square root of 2, which is the maximum allowed OMI for a given optical power at the transmitter.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have provided an analysis of receiver sensitivities in microwave-based all-analogle (orthogonal) SCM microwave-optical links.
we developed a theoretical model for calculating the sensitivity of SCM and orthogonal SCM receivers.
the receiver sensitivity in SCM links depends on the OMI at the transmitter and the link parameters, and that the optimum OMI can be predicted by a simple mathematical model.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the sensitivity of a SCM receiver is not only a function of the OMI, but it also depends on the link and the transmitter, which can be exploited to optimize the link performance.
the receiver sensitivity in a SCM link is a complex function of the link parameters, the OMI, and the optical modulation format.
in the case of orthogonal SCM the receiver sensitivity can be increased by a factor 2 with respect to the conventional SCM.
